statement: Pricing pressure in generics expected to stabilize in next 6 months to a year
quote: It is very hard to answer that particular question, but that is the hope that in the next six months to a year, we should see at least some stability with respect to the pricing pressure.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote explicitly mentions stability expected in next 6 months to a year.

statement: Strong engagement with key customers in Contrast Media segment moving from qualifications to commercial supplies
quote: Our Contrast Media segment is another area of noticeable progress, where we are currently engaging with most of our key customers and our projects are moving through various stages from qualifications to commercial supplies.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote confirms strong engagement and moving from qualification to commercial supplies.

statement: Advancing shipments by 3-4 weeks, maintaining extended safety stock, diversifying supply base to mitigate Red Sea logistics disruptions
quote: To mitigate the risks related to inventory management, we have adopted a proactive approach, by advancing shipments by three to four weeks, maintaining extended safety stock levels and diversifying our supply base, wherever feasible.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote states advancing shipments by 3-4 weeks, extended safety stock, and supply base diversification.

statement: Transit times extended from 45 days to ~70 days due to Red Sea crisis routing via South Africa
quote: This change has extended our transit times from around 45 days to approximately 70 days and raised associated logistics costs.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote matches transit times extension from 45 days to ~70 days.

name: Kuantum Papers Ltd
statement: NSR bottomed out at INR72,000/ton, upward trend post Q2 FY25
quote: Yes. Clearly, this will be the bottomed out position.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote states bottomed out position, but 72,000 value comes from adjacent context.

name: Kuantum Papers Ltd
statement: Wood pulp costs stable, managed at same level as last year
quote: Wood pulp continues to be the same. Wood pulp is being managed at very, very similar cost. No change either upward or downward in the cost from the last year.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote confirms wood pulp costs managed at same level as last year.

name: Kuantum Papers Ltd
statement: Exports impacted by Red Sea crisis affecting Gulf and European routes
quote: So this is that Red Sea crisis, which is happening. Gulf channel is at the moment under d uress with all those pirates and all operating in that area, and that is what has impacted exports
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote confirms Red Sea crisis impacted exports to Gulf and European destinations.

name: Kuantum Papers Ltd
statement: Industry represented to government on import pressure, IPMA filed pre-budget memorandum

name: Steel Strips Wheels Ltd-$
statement: Evaluating hot stamping for OEM relationships; targeting dominant global aluminium wheel player; further aluminium/knuckles expansion likely if export profile sustains

speaker: mgmt
note: Quote mentions hot stamping and OEM discussions, but lacks FY27+ or dominant player details.

name: Steel Strips Wheels Ltd-$
statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA per wheel INR314 vs INR262 in Q1 FY26; margin expanded 40 bps driven by input price increases, operating leverage, premium mix, cost optimization
quote: Standalone EBITDA with other income for the quarter increased by 32% Y-o-Y and stood at INR165.17 crores. EBITDA per wheel for current quarter stands at INR314 per wheel as compared to INR262 per wheel in the Quarter 1 FY26. Margin percentages expanded during the quarter by 40 bps, driven by input increases received from OEMs other than raw materials, operating leverage, a favourable product mix a
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote fully supports EBITDA per wheel figures and margin expansion drivers.

name: Steel Strips Wheels Ltd-$
statement: FY27 capex estimated at INR600 crores+/- including Bhuj aluminium wheel (1.2M), knuckles (1.1M), replacement/other plant capex, and agricultural wheel brownfield expansion
quote: So in all, as Pranav said INR420 crores for these 2 plus INR80 crores for the Brownfield, INR500 crores. So let's say, INR600 crores plus/minus, you could sort of benchmark this as a capex for this year.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote benchmarks capex as INR600 crores plus/minus.

name: Steel Strips Wheels Ltd-$
statement: Claims lowest-cost producer ex-China for steel and alloy wheels; two serious players dominate aluminium wheel market; domestic alloy margins crashing but not chasing below-cost business
quote: That will be a great assertion. And I believe that it's about 80% to 90% true. I don't know what the costs in China are because a lot of Chinese companies have subsidies. But if you look at ex China, then hands down, we are the lowest cost producer.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote supports lowest-cost producer ex-China claim, but does not mention domestic alloy margins or other parts.
